summary: Iteration 141 — Service Session Flow. Independent backend verification via pytest (8/8 PASS): OTP visibility for customer + OTP strip for partner on assigned sub; wrong OTP -> 400 'Invalid customer start OTP'; complete-before-start -> 400 'Day already marked as scheduled'; start with correct OTP -> in_progress + started_at stamped; complete with base64 png photo -> completed + proof_photo is https URL under /media/file/subscriptions/ + accrued_earning increases; future-day start/complete -> 400 'This service day has not arrived yet'; unassigned partner (Raj Kumar) -> 403 'This subscription is not assigned to you'; regressions: backdated complete without OTP still works (past scheduled day), admin /admin/{id}/days/{date} maid_absent still works. Customer web UI smoke: /account?tab=subscriptions renders, [data-testid=my-subscriptions] present, amber OTP banner [data-testid^=my-sub-otp-] appears on the active daily sub we created ("Today's service OTP: 4085 — share with your maid to start the service"). Note: real system date is 2026-09-27 (Sunday UTC) which is weekly_off for Home Maid; test fixture patches today's day to 'scheduled' in MongoDB to exercise the live start flow.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/controllers/subscription_controller.py::partner_start_day compares day.otp using str() equality — resilient to number/string OTPs. Consider constant-time compare (hmac.compare_digest) for hardening against timing attacks, though impact is minor for 4-digit OTPs behind rate-limited endpoints.

partner_mark_completed accepts photo up to whatever storage_service.materialize_data_url allows (max_side=1280). No explicit size cap on the incoming base64 payload before decode — a malicious/oversized data URL could burden the request. Consider a request-body size limit or a length check before materialize.

SUB* short codes referenced in the review request (SUBZXRGVG, SUBOI7PPF, SUB445IQ2) are stored as 'code' on the subscription doc, but the API returns the internal UUID as 'id'. Downstream tests/tooling that key off SUB* will silently skip; confirming this is intentional and documented would help.

Home Maid service has Sunday weekly_off; on Sundays UTC the 'today' scheduled day won't exist naturally, so fixtures must inject/patch it (see test_iter141_session_flow.py fresh_daily_sub fixture). Partner /subscriptions/partner/mine returns internal UUID id (not the SUB* short code).
